Concretely, change C4's match condition from requiring the exact string "no wireless network connection" to accepting any value that contains both "no wireless" and "connection" (or equivalently, accept either "no wireless connection" or "no wireless network connection"). This is a minimal wording loosening that addresses the single observed encoding mismatch. No changes are needed to PF2, shared_context, or any other check, since all other checks passed in all 4 rollouts.
